title: tk herd orchestrate is deferred with no tick trail
description:
docs/design/orchestrator-continuation.md section 4 defers `tk herd orchestrate <epic>` — spawning the orchestrator through the helper with its kind full-auto template, which would also eliminate the `blocked`-on-permission-prompt stall class.

Blocked on a herdr wire shape: internal/herd/client/protocol.go models no pane-creation method other than worktree.create, and this repo does not guess wire shapes. Needs a pane-at-controller-checkout method pinned against a live herdr.

Filed so the deferral is tracked rather than living only in a design doc. Note the spawn-arming change reduces its urgency: watchdog registration, one of its four stated benefits, is now automatic.
acceptance_criteria: Either the herdr method exists and tk herd orchestrate ships, or the tick records the decision not to build it.
